Correct the syntax error in the code.

Reply with the complete corrected module in a ```verilog code block.

Problem Description:
Given an 8-bit input vector [7:0], reverse its bit ordering.

module top_module (
	input [7:0] in,
	output [7:0] out
);

Erroneous Implementation:

always @(posedge clk) begin
		out[0] <= in[7];
		out[1] <= in[6];
		out[2] <= in[5];
		out[3] <= in[4];
		out[4] <= in[3];
		out[5] <= in[2];
		out[6] <= in[1];
		out[7] <= in[0];
	end

endmodule
